value.rationale: Complete sharp classification across all possible single-sweep permutations of the first genuine periodic four-node SPD screened-Poisson graph. Distinguishes worst-case energy performance from asymptotic spectral convergence, shows a strict penalty for the parallel red–black ordering, and quantifies an almost factor-two disparity as coupling weakens. This is a natural nontrivial finite problem with a practical communication-versus-contraction interpretation, not a routine perturbation or known-table recomputation.
